maddeler.e:
اعتبرت (form VIII)
# اِعْتَبَرْتُ (iʕtabartu) /iʕ.ta.bar.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِعْتَبَرَ (iʕtabara)
# اِعْتَبَرْتَ (iʕtabarta) /iʕ.ta.bar.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِعْتَبَرَ (iʕtabara)
# اِعْتَبَرْتِ (iʕtabarti) /iʕ.ta.bar.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِعْتَبَرَ (iʕtabara)
# اِعْتَبَرَتْ (iʕtabarat) /iʕ.ta.ba.rat/: third-perso
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
